entries.zh: 裂开、破裂；（布帛衣缝）绽裂
entries.en: to split, crack, tear open; (of seams) to come unstitched, come apart
to tear apart, rip open; to split

entries.zh: 拆缝，把缝好的针脚拆开（拆开缝口）
entries.en: to unpick a seam, unrip the stitching
light; to bring to light, illuminate
entries.notes: M 栏有 T99 污损且作两读 cūy : cóng（疑含「開光」之义），故列低置信。

entries.zh: 耀，照耀；显耀、炫示（彰显于光）
entries.en: to shine, give light; to dazzle, make conspicuous

entries.zh: 供出、招供，把秘密实情吐露出来
entries.en: to confess, give away (a secret); to depose

entries.zh: 承认、认下（自己认承其事）；认明
entries.en: to admit, acknowledge; to identify oneself
to lift open, pull back (a curtain)

entries.notes: L 列 falsas agenas 疑为 falsas ajenas 之写误，未足确解；词义依汉字 叛 与对音 Pǒan/poān 定。
第二字存疑（[疑:黄/菱]），M 栏有 T99 污损且列间音节不对应，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 赃，赃物；赃证败露，凭迹象查获
entries.en: stolen goods, loot; to be discovered through clues (evidence)
entries.notes: L 列 in di cios 应为 indicios（迹象）之拆写，与 赃 以「凭赃证发觉盗情」相扣。

entries.zh: 臭青，腥臊臭味；气味外露而被嗅出、败露
entries.en: foul, raw (fishy) smell; to be found out by scent or telltale signs
entries.notes: 臭青为闽南「腥臊味」之词，与 descubrir por indicios（凭迹象发觉）以气味迹兆相扣，属语境推断。

entries.zh: 相互串通、通同（彼此通气共谋）；互相泄露机密
entries.en: to collude with one another, be in league; to share secrets mutually
entries.notes: M 栏音节数与汉字三字不合且含 T99 污损；释义据 L descubrir el secreto 与 相通同（串通）定。

entries.zh: 通传反情，泄露谋反机密；串通谋反
entries.en: to leak secrets of rebellion, disclose treason
entries.notes: M 栏有 T99 污损；据 L descubrir el secreto 与 通反 字面（通传反情）定。

entries.zh: 实供，如实招供、据实供述
entries.en: truthful confession; to confess truthfully, depose honestly
entries.notes: 首字有 [疑:實/宴]，M 栏有污损；M/R 读 sit / còng 支持「實供」，与 L con verdad（据实）相合。

entries.zh: 显耀，显扬、公开彰显（炫耀于人）
entries.en: to display prominently, make publicly known, show off
